defs.def: in, to or at every place; all places 处处；到处；各个地方；所有地方

ex.s: A few days later, I came back with my first jars of zero waste groceries, and my dad commented on how silly it was for me to carry jars everywhere.
ex.t: 几天后，我带着第一批零浪费杂货罐回来，我爸爸评论说，我到处带着罐子真是傻。

ex.s: She and her husband have spent the last two years traveling the world, stopping everywhere from Paris to Singapore.
ex.t: 她和丈夫在过去两年里周游世界，足迹从巴黎到新加坡。

ex.s: It used to be that you  drive for miles here without seeing another person, but now there are houses and people everywhere.
ex.t: 过去在这里你可以开车数英里看不到一个人但现在到处都是房子和人。

ex.s: Tiny pieces of glass were everywhere.
ex.t: 细小的玻璃碎片到处都是。

ex.s: No design is well received everywhere
ex.t: 没有哪种设计在各地都受欢迎

ex.s: SILENCE in big black letters was on signs hung everywhere If she thought you were dressed improperly, she sent you straight back home to change your clothes.
ex.t: 用大写字母写的"安静"标志到处都是如果她觉得你穿得不合适，她会直接让你回家换衣服。
各地的父母都称赞他们的孩子。

ex.s: Most of us， in fact， progressively narrow the variety of our lives． We succeed in our field of specialization and then become trapped in it． Nothing surprises us． We lose our sense of wonder． But， if we are willing to learn， the opportunities are everywhere．
ex.t: 事实上，我们大多数人都在逐渐缩小生活的多样性。我们在自己的专业领域取得成功，然后便被困其中。没有什么能让我们感到惊讶。我们失去了好奇心。但是，如果我们愿意学习，机会无处不在。

ex.s: Dance in the US is everywhere.
It’s hard to predict when driverless cars will be everywhere on our roads.
ex.t: 很难预测无人驾驶汽车何时会在我们的道路上随处可见。

ex.s: More ordinary forms of adaptation are happening everywhere.
ex.t: 更为普通的适应形式正在各地发生。

ex.s: Because I thought ballet was more or less the same everywhere, I was totally unprepared for its unique beauty.
ex.t: 因为我原以为芭蕾舞无论在哪里都大同小异，所以对它独特的美毫无准备。

ex.s: Actually, art is everywhere around us!
ex.t: 其实，艺术就在我们身边！

ex.s: It’s easy to see great art nowadays, because people are creating it everywhere you look.
ex.t: 如今看伟大的艺术作品很容易，因为人们随处都在创造艺术。

ex.s: There was water everywhere, but we couldn’t drink any of it otherwise we’d get really sick.
ex.t: 到处都是水，但我们一滴也不能喝，否则会病得很重。

改编本 是 发生 处处
是 创造 它 处处
